skill.body:
# Theatre.js Best Practices

Motion design editor and animation library for the web. Provides a visual timeline editor (Studio) with programmatic control.

## Installation

```bash
# Core + Studio (development)
npm install @theatre/core@0.7 @theatre/studio@0.7

# React Three Fiber integration
npm install @theatre/r3f@0.7

# React utilities
npm install @theatre/react

# Theatric (simplified controls)
npm install theatric
```

## Quick Start

```tsx
import * as core from '@theatre/core'
import studio from '@theatre/studio'

// Initialize Studio (dev only)
if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
  studio.initialize()
}

// Create project → sheet → object
const project = core.getProject('My Project')
const sheet = project.sheet('Main')
const obj = sheet.object('Box', {
  position: { x: 0, y: 0 },
  opacity: 1
})

// Read values
console.log(obj.value.position.x)

// Listen to changes
obj.onValuesChange((values) => {
  element.style.opacity = values.opacity
  element.style.transform = `translate(${values.position.x}px, ${values.position.y}px)`
})

// Play animation
sheet.sequence.play({ iterationCount: Infinity })
```

## Core Concepts

| Concept | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Project** | Container for all animation data; maps to exported JSON state |
| **Sheet** | A scene or component; contains objects and one sequence |
| **Object** | Animatable entity with typed props |
| **Sequence** | Timeline with keyframes; controls playback |
| **Props** | Typed values (number, compound, rgba, etc.) |

## Reference Index

| Reference | Use When |
|-----------|----------|
| `references/01-core.md` | Project setup, sheets, objects, sequences, playback control |
| `references/02-prop-types.md` | Defining props, custom types, compound props, constraints |
| `references/03-studio.md` | Studio UI, keyboard shortcuts, extensions, panels |
| `references/04-react-integration.md` | useVal, usePrism, @theatre/react hooks |
| `references/05-r3f-integration.md` | React Three Fiber, editable components, SheetProvider |
| `references/06-production.md` | Export state, assets, deployment, tree-shaking |

## Common Patterns

### Animate DOM Element

```tsx
const obj = sheet.object('Card', {
  x: 0,
  y: 0,
  rotation: 0,
  scale: 1,
  opacity: 1
})

obj.onValuesChange(({ x, y, rotation, scale, opacity }) => {
  element.style.transform = `translate(${x}px, ${y}px) rotate(${rotation}deg) scale(${scale})`
  element.style.opacity = opacity
})
```

### Sequence Playback Control

```tsx
const seq = sheet.sequence

// Play once
seq.play()

// Play with options
seq.play({
  iterationCount: Infinity,  // loop forever
  range: [0, 2],             // play seconds 0-2
  rate: 1.5,                 // 1.5x speed
  direction: 'alternate'     // ping-pong
})

// Pause and seek
seq.pause()
seq.position = 1.5  // jump to 1.5s

// Await completion
await seq.play({ iterationCount: 1 })
console.log('Animation complete')
```

### React Three Fiber Scene

```tsx
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { editable as e, SheetProvider } from '@theatre/r3f'
import { getProject } from '@theatre/core'
import studio from '@theatre/studio'
import extension from '@theatre/r3f/dist/extension'

// Dev setup
if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
  studio.initialize()
  studio.extend(extension)
}

const sheet = getProject('R3F Demo').sheet('Scene')

function App() {
  return (
    <Canvas>
      <SheetProvider sheet={sheet}>
        <e.mesh theatreKey="Cube">
          <boxGeometry />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="orange" />
        </e.mesh>
        <e.pointLight theatreKey="Light" position={[10, 10, 10]} />
      </SheetProvider>
    </Canvas>
  )
}
```

### Theatric Controls (Simple)

```tsx
import { useControls, types } from 'theatric'

function Component() {
  const { color, intensity, position } = useControls({
    color: '#ff0000',
    intensity: types.number(1, { range: [0, 2] }),
    position: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }
  })

  return <mesh position={[position.x, position.y, position.z]} />
}
```

## Critical Mistakes to Avoid

### 1. Studio in Production
```tsx
// ❌ Includes studio in bundle
import studio from '@theatre/studio'
studio.initialize()

// ✅ Dev-only initialization
if (import.meta.env.DEV) {
  studio.initialize()
}
```

### 2. Missing State in Production
```tsx
// ❌ No animations without state
const project = core.getProject('My Project')

// ✅ Load exported state
import state from './state.json'
const project = core.getProject('My Project', { state })
```

### 3. Object Key Collisions
```tsx
// ❌ Same key = same object (shared state)
sheet.object('Box', { x: 0 })
sheet.object('Box', { y: 0 })  // Overwrites!

// ✅ Unique keys per object
sheet.object('Box1', { x: 0 })
sheet.object('Box2', { y: 0 })
```

### 4. Missing R3F Extension
```tsx
// ❌ No 3D controls in Studio
studio.initialize()

// ✅ Extend with R3F extension
import extension from '@theatre/r3f/dist/extension'
studio.initialize()
studio.extend(extension)
```

### 5. Forgetting theatreKey
```tsx
// ❌ Not editable
<e.mesh>

// ✅ Requires theatreKey
<e.mesh theatreKey="MyCube">
```

## Quick Reference

| Task | Solution |
|------|----------|
| Create project | `getProject('Name', { state? })` |
| Create sheet | `project.sheet('Name')` |
| Create object | `sheet.object('Key', { props })` |
| Listen to values | `obj.onValuesChange(cb)` |
| Read value | `obj.value.propName` |
| Play animation | `sheet.sequence.play(opts?)` |
| Pause animation | `sheet.sequence.pause()` |
| Seek position | `sheet.sequence.position = 1.5` |
| R3F editable | `<e.mesh theatreKey="Key">` |
| React value hook | `useVal(obj.props.x)` |
| Export state | Studio → Project → Export (JSON) |

generated_query: I'm building a 3D product configurator in React Three Fiber where users can rotate and zoom around a product. I want to add smooth, keyframed animations for product spin, camera fly-arounds, and color changes. I'd like to use a visual timeline editor to tweak these animations interactively during development, and then have them play back automatically on page load. Can you help me set up the animation system? I'll need to create a project with a sheet, define animatable props like rotation, camera position, color, and have the ability to control playback (play, pause, loop). Also, I want to ensure the editor is only loaded in development mode and that the final build uses the exported animation state.

edit_instructions.rationale: Deleting the state loading step removes the ability to play animations on page load, which is required for automatic playback.

# Theatre.js Programmatic Animation System

Animation library for declarative, keyframed motion in JavaScript/TypeScript. This guide covers programmatic timeline creation and playback control without the visual editor.

## Installation

```bash
# Core (no studio required for production)
npm install @theatre/core@0.7

# React Three Fiber integration
npm install @theatre/r3f@0.7

# React hooks (optional)
npm install @theatre/react
```

## Quick Start

```tsx
import * as core from '@theatre/core'

// Create project & sheet
const project = core.getProject('Configurator')
const sheet = project.sheet('Main')

// Define animatable object with typed props
const product = sheet.object('Product', {
  rotationX: 0,
  rotationY: 0,
})

// Set keyframes programmatically
sheet.sequence.onPositionChanged((pos) => {
  // Trigger re-render using your state manager
})
```

## Core Concepts

| Concept | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| **Project** | Container for all animation data |
| **Sheet** | Scene container with one sequence |
| **Object** | Animatable entity with typed props |
| **Sequence** | Timeline with keyframes; controls playback |
| **Props** | Typed values (number, compound, etc.) |

## Animation Setup (No Visual Editor)

Use `sheet.sequence.addKeyframe()` to define keyframes in code:

```tsx
const seq = sheet.sequence

// Add keyframes for a rotation animation
seq.addKeyframe('Product.rotationY', 0, 0)      // start at 0s
seq.addKeyframe('Product.rotationY', Math.PI * 2, 4) // end at 4s

// Add keyframes for camera position (if defined as object props)
seq.addKeyframe('Camera.position.x', 0, 0)
seq.addKeyframe('Camera.position.x', 5, 3)
```

## Common Patterns

### React Three Fiber Integration (Basic)

```tsx
import { Canvas } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { editable as e } from '@theatre/r3f'
import { getProject } from '@theatre/core'

const sheet = getProject('Configurator').sheet('Scene')

function Product() {
  return (
    <group>
      <e.mesh theatreKey="Product" rotation={[0, 0, 0]}>
        <boxGeometry args={[2, 1, 1]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="orange" />
      </e.mesh>
    </group>
  )
}

function App() {
  return (
    <Canvas>
      <SheetProvider sheet={sheet}>
        <Product />
        {/* Static camera – not animated from props */}
        <perspectiveCamera position={[0, 0, 5]} />
      </SheetProvider>
    </Canvas>
  )
}
```

### Playback Control

```tsx
const seq = sheet.sequence

// Play once
seq.play({ iterationCount: 1 })

// Loop continuously
seq.play({ iterationCount: Infinity })

// Pause
seq.pause()

// Seek to position (seconds)
seq.position = 2.5

// Change playback speed
seq.play({ rate: 2 })
```

### Automatic Playback on Load

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
  const seq = sheet.sequence
  seq.play({ iterationCount: Infinity })
}, [])
```

## Critical Mistakes to Avoid

### 1. No Visual Feedback During Development

You define all keyframes in code. There is no drag-and-drop timeline. To preview changes, re-run the app.

### 2. Sequence Position Must Be Set Explicitly

```tsx
// ❌ Sequence defaults to end position
// ✅ Reset to start before play
seq.position = 0
seq.play()
```

### 3. Props Are Limited to Numbers

Compound props (like RGBA colors) require manual interpolation. Color changes are not directly supported as animatable props.

```tsx
// ❌ Colour as prop not directly animatable
const obj = sheet.object('Light', { color: '#ff0000' })  // Will cause errors

// ✅ Use separate numeric props for RGB
const obj = sheet.object('Light', {
  r: 1, g: 0, b: 0
})
```

### 4. Camera Animations Require Extra Work

Theatre.js does not natively manage Three.js camera transforms. You must create an object with position/rotation props and update the camera manually.

## Quick Reference

| Task | Solution |
|------|----------|
| Create project | `core.getProject('name')` |
| Create sheet | `project.sheet('name')` |
| Create object | `sheet.object('key', { props })` |
| Add keyframe | `seq.addKeyframe('object.prop', value, time)` |
| Play sequence | `seq.play({ iterationCount: Infinity })` |
| Pause | `seq.pause()` |
| Seek | `seq.position = seconds` |
| React component | `<SheetProvider sheet={sheet}><e.mesh theatreKey="key" /></SheetProvider>` |
| Read value | `obj.value.propName` |
